content: SQLite WAL mode: writes commit to a separate -wal file first; readers and a writer can proceed concurrently without blocking; on crash, SQLite replays the WAL on next open to reach a consistent state. This is the SQL analogue of the append-only-JSONL durability pattern already used in queue.mjs. Enable with PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL (persists in the file header); pair with busy_timeout for SQLITE_BUSY retries.
